results.question: Which category had the most unusual month?
results.sql: WITH monthly_sums AS (SELECT category_id, substr(posted_date,1,7) AS month, SUM(amount) AS month_sum FROM transactions WHERE type='purchase' GROUP BY category_id, month), category_avg AS (SELECT category_id, AVG(month_sum) AS avg_sum FROM monthly_sums GROUP BY category_id), deviations AS (SELECT m.category_id, ABS(m.month_sum - a.avg_sum) AS dev FROM monthly_sums m JOIN category_avg a ON m.category_id = a.category_id), max_dev_per_cat AS (SELECT category_id, MAX(dev) AS max_dev FROM deviations GROUP BY category_id) SELECT c.name FROM max_dev_per_cat md JOIN categories c ON c.id = md.category_id ORDER BY md.max_dev DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Did my spending drop unusually low in any category?
results.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT c.name AS category,
         substr(t.posted_date,1,7) AS month,
         SUM(t.amount) AS total
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id
  WHERE t.type = 'purchase'
  GROUP BY c.id, month
),
avg_spending AS (
  SELECT category, AVG(total) AS avg_total
  FROM monthly
  GROUP BY category
),
low AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM monthly m
  JOIN avg_spending a ON m.category = a.category
  WHERE m.total > a.avg_total * 0.5
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM low) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS spending_drop_unusually_low

results.question: How many category-months look statistically unusual?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT ct.category_id,
           ct.month,
           ct.total,
           s.mean,
           s.stddev
    FROM (
        SELECT t.category_id,
               substr(t.posted_date,1,7) AS month,
               SUM(t.amount) AS total
        FROM transactions t
        WHERE t.type = 'purchase'
        GROUP BY t.category_id, month
    ) ct
    JOIN (
        SELECT category_id,
               AVG(month_total) AS mean,
               sqrt(AVG(month_total*month_total) - AVG(month_total)*AVG(month_total)) AS stddev
        FROM (
            SELECT t.category_id,
                   substr(t.posted_date,1,7) AS month,
                   SUM(t.amount) AS month_total
            FROM transactions t
            WHERE t.type = 'purchase'
            GROUP BY t.category_id, month
        )
        GROUP BY category_id
    ) s ON ct.category_id = s.category_id
    WHERE ct.total < s.mean - 2 * s.stddev
       OR ct.total > s.mean + 2 * s.stddev
)
